Configuration.description: Default build configuration for build workflows.

GameDir.description: Absolute path to game install directory containing FFX.exe.

AutoDeploy.description: Automatic deploy behavior after build. Null means first-time interactive prompt.

DeployPreservePaths.description: Paths to preserve during deploy sync. Supports relative paths under <GameDir>\fahrenheit and absolute paths.

VisionApiUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for local OCR vision calls.

VisionApiKey.description: API key or environment variable reference in $env:VAR format.

VisionModel.description: Model id for local OCR vision passes.

FetchRetries.description: Number of additional retries for remote source fetches.

DiscordToken.description: Discord token or environment variable reference in $env:VAR format.
